# Disposable email inbox services — throwaway inboxes anyone can claim in
# seconds without proving identity. Signups using these are rejected at
# account creation.

# Format: one bare domain per line, lowercase. Lines starting with `#` are
# comments. The gate also blocks ANY subdomain of a listed domain (e.g.
# `anything.mailinator.com`), so only the bare service domain is needed.
# Source of truth for src/convex/emailDomainList.ts (generated by
# scripts/generate-email-domain-list.mjs — keep them in sync).
